start.card:
Two hospitals: a big one where 45 babies are born each day, and a small one with 15.
Over one year, which has more days when over 60% of the babies (more than 6 in every 10) are boys?
Make a guess first.
start.title: Big and Small Hospitals

afterGuess.card:
You guessed: the big hospital. Let's test it.
Press "Run 1 day" to see one day of births in each hospital.
afterGuess.title: Big and Small Hospitals

after.card:
The small hospital now has 45 babies a day.
Press "Run a new year" to count the days again.
after.title: Big and Small Hospitals
